layers.note: Renders are 4 px per cell, north up. textures.png: dominant texture per cell; elevation.png: cliff levels (darker = cliff edge, blue = ramp); doodads.png: doodads by kind, manipulated ones ringed red; vertex-shading.png: t3VertCol kind-1 values (white untouched), cliff edges blue. Outside the playable bounds is dimmed.

texturing.note: Shares normalise each cell's 8 mask weights to sum to 1; 'present' means >= 10% of a cell's mix.

blendPlacement.note: mixedNearBorder: share of mixed cells within 2 cells of a dominant-texture border; cellsNearBorder: share of all playable cells that close.

manipulation.note: tilted: |pitch| or |roll| > 0.05 rad; nonUniformScale: axis ratio > 1.15; sunk/raised: > 0.5 below/above terrain; extremeScale: >= 2 or <= 0.5.

lighting.note: Lighting is switched by triggers per area or story beat; 'calls' lists every GameSetLighting and the function making it.

vertexShading.note: t3VertCol kind-1 per-vertex values; a cell is darkened when its corner mean < 224. Painted or baked is unverified.
